title: Agent performance
description: Crew vs other agents, from runs/agents.jsonl shipped by `watermill ship`. See docs/OBSERVABILITY.md.

panels.title: Records per kind per week
panels.description: Count of agents.jsonl records by bucketed agent_kind (mill-crew, session, subagent, other), filed on the day the work ended (7-day rolling window). mill-crew counts ONLY the handoff record (one per bead): EXCLUDES transcript records of crew role runs (detail.crew_key links them to the bead), so a bead is not counted once per millstone/sluice/tailrace run. Unlanded crew beads are not shipped, so they are not counted.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_kind) (count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" [7d]))

panels.title: Crew beads landed per week
panels.description: Mill-crew records with outcome=landed, by landing week. Crew only; other kinds define their own outcome vocabulary and are not compared here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" | outcome="landed" [7d]))

panels.title: Sluice rounds per bead (weekly mean)
panels.description: Mean and max detail.sluice_rounds over mill-crew beads shipped that week (7-day rolling window). Crew only, handoff records only. Counted from handoff notes (the Sluice sections); beads with no Sluice section count 0. Grouped by agent_kind so it is one series, not one per bead.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" | detail_sluice_rounds != "" | unwrap detail_sluice_rounds | __error__="" [7d]) by (agent_kind)

max_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" | detail_sluice_rounds != "" | unwrap detail_sluice_rounds | __error__="" [7d]) by (agent_kind)

panels.title: Median duration by kind (seconds)
panels.description: Median duration_seconds per bucketed kind. EXCLUDES every record whose duration_seconds is null or non-numeric -- today that is every mill-crew record (duration is only filled when stated), so the crew line is empty until a source supplies it. Do not read a missing line as zero.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | duration_seconds != "" | unwrap duration_seconds | __error__="" [7d]) by (agent_kind)

panels.title: Cost and tokens by kind (weekly sums)
panels.description: Sum of cost_usd, detail.input_tokens and detail.output_tokens per bucketed kind (7-day rolling window). EXCLUDES records where the field is null or absent: cost is null on every mill-crew handoff record; token counts exist only on transcript records (sessions, subagents, and crew role runs). Cache tokens (detail.cache_creation_tokens, detail.cache_read_tokens) are EXCLUDED. A kind with no line has no data, not zero spend.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_kind) (sum_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | cost_usd != "" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [7d]))
sum by (agent_kind) (sum_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | detail_input_tokens != "" | unwrap detail_input_tokens | __error__="" [7d]))
sum by (agent_kind) (sum_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | detail_output_tokens != "" | unwrap detail_output_tokens | __error__="" [7d]))

panels.title: Crew first-pass approval rate (one Sluice round, no fixes)
panels.description: NOT the keep rate of docs/OBSERVABILITY.md (completed tasks / all tasks). Of landed mill-crew beads that went through a Sluice review (detail.sluice_pushed_fixes is true or false), the share that landed after exactly one Sluice round (detail.sluice_rounds = 1) with no fixes pushed by Sluice. EXCLUDES beads with no Sluice section (field null) and transcript records; rests on inferred fields (fields_inferred lists detail.sluice_pushed_fixes), so treat it as indicative. Crew only.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" | outcome="landed" | detail_sluice_rounds="1" | detail_sluice_pushed_fixes="false" [7d])) / sum(count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | source_extracted="handoff" | outcome="landed" | detail_sluice_pushed_fixes=~"true|false" [7d]))
